De siste årene har vi tilbrakt mye av vår tid i Haiti og tjent på misjonsmarken. Av og til har vi reist tilbake til Amerika for besøk av ulik lengde og med forskjellige grunner. Hver tur tilbake til USA har vært utfordrende idet vi har observert forandringene—endringer i kultur, i teknologi, i verdier osv. Noen ganger, når familien min ser på vårt land, virker det som om det er lite håp. Klart nok tar ondskapen over. For meg er imidlertid den endringen som virker mest bekymringsfull, kirkens endring. De fleste, om ikke alle, gudfryktige kristne ser tydelig landets moralske forfall, men hva med våre kirker? Holder kirken fast ved bibelsk lære, eller følger den verden i gradvis forandring og kompromiss?

Alt i alt synes den amerikanske kirke å blomstre økonomisk. Våre bedrifter går bedre, sammen med levestandarden, mens mange kristne åndelig sett ser ut til å miste sin nidkjærhet for fromhet. Hvordan vil kirken se ut om 40, 50 eller 80 år?

Når vi leser Apostlenes gjerninger, ser vi noe om og om igjen. Guds kraft blir åpenbart, og sjeler blir lagt til riket—daglig.

Vanligvis, når folk ser noe de trenger, går de etter det. Når de ser noe de er sikre på at de må ha, kan de til og med bli desperate eller radikale i sin jakt på å få det.

Jesus forteller lignelsen om et jorde som inneholder en tapt eller skjult skatt—Igen: Himmelriket er som en skatt gjemt i et jorde; den som finner den gjemmer den igjen, og i sin glede går han bort og selger alt han eier og kjøper det jordstykke – Matteus 13:44.

Her har du en mann som kanskje er fornøyd med sitt liv. Han har eiendeler og god helse. Mens han går hjem, ser han noe han aldri har sett før, noe av stor verdi, noe han må ha. Ingen trengte å tvinge ham til å handle. Det tok heller ikke dager eller uker før han slo til—han så det og bestemte seg for at han måtte ha det med én gang. Så gikk han og solgte alt han eide. (Å selge «det meste» ville ikke kjøpt jordstykket. Nei, han må selge alt.) Etter at han kjøper jordet, eier han nå det viktigste i verden. Han vil beholde det for alltid, han vil aldri skilles fra det, uansett hva det koster. Han forstår også at denne skatten ikke bare er god for ham, men for hele menneskeheten. Faktisk forstår han snart at hvis han ikke finner denne skatten, så selger alt han har og kjøper skatten, så vil han gå fortapt—for alltid. Folk rundt ham forstår ham kanskje ikke—hans handlinger, hans beslutninger, hans bevegelser—de kan være forvirret i starten over hvorfor han gjorde som han gjorde. Men de vil ikke være forvirret om én ting—denne skatten var verdt hele verden for denne mannen. Hans kjærlighet til den kan ikke nektes.

Denne mannen har nå noe i seg som gir uttrykk for kjærlighet, glede, fred, langmodighet, vennlighet, godhet, tro, saktmodighet, måtehold… – Galaterne 5:22-23, som er Åndens frukt. Han ser ut til å ha en særskilt kraft over seg. Han overkommer lidelse og vanskeligheter med letthet—i det minste slik det ser ut for dem som ser på. Han bærer ingen nag og elsker til og med sine fiender. Virkelig har denne mannen funnet noe det er verdt å selge alt for. Så, se og se, begynner andre å selge det de har, for også å eie denne skatten.

I følge Bibelen forventes Guds folk å være verdens lys og jordens salt. La oss seriøst og ærlig stille oss dette spørsmålet: «Opplever de rundt oss oss som bibelsk lys og salt?!»

I tiden for Apostlenes gjerninger var det klare skiller, og kirken vokste. Ja, den led; men den vokste likevel, til tider daglig.

Når jeg reiser til forskjellige samfunn, ser jeg noe vanskelig å forstå. Det finnes visse grupper mennesker som ser annerledes ut enn verden rundt dem, men likevel ser ut til å oppføre seg som hovedstrømmen i Amerika. Deres interesser er de samme; deres ønsker er de samme. Jeg har undret meg over hvorfor de fortsetter å se annerledes ut enn verden mens de synes å ha de samme verdiene.

Jeg var i en dagligvarebutikk da en kvinne jeg aldri hadde sett før, kom bort til meg. Hun var svært munter og stilte meg noen tilfeldige spørsmål, så før hun gikk sa hun: «Jeg elsker dere mennonitter; dere er så søte!» Det var hjerteskjærende—vi vekket ikke omvendelse i hennes hjerte. Vi ga henne ikke engang et eksempel. I stedet underholdt vi henne bare.

I Haiti ville familien min gå inn i en kirke eller et åndelig møte, og kvinnene ville dra i miniskjørtet sitt, og fortvilet forsøke å dekke sin nakenhet. Jeg har til og med sett noen ta av seg smykkene uten at vi sa et ord! Lys avslører mørke: det gir overbevisning. Det er derfor kristne pleide å bli hatet av dem rundt seg.

Så hvorfor er vi et kulturshow for verden? Hva har endret seg? Kan det være at vi ganske enkelt gjengir de kulturelle normene som verden setter pris på? Forlater vi Gud mens vi fortsetter med de ting verden har kommet til å akseptere?

Når Nikodemus kom til Jesus, begynte han straks å rose Herren og sa …vi vet at du er en lærer som er kommet fra Gud; for ingen kan gjøre disse tegnene du gjør, dersom ikke Gud er med ham – Johannes 3:2.

Men Jesus ser ut til å overse disse ordene og går rett på sak når han sier: Sannelig, sannelig sier jeg deg: Om en ikke blir født på ny, kan han ikke se Guds rike – Johannes 3:3. Det er nesten som om han sier, [«Selv om du kommer for å søke, du synes å inneha noe sannhet, og du er en av jødenes ledere, men det første du må kjenne til er dette: Du må bli født på ny.»] Kraftfulle ord. Han fortsetter så med å uttale det åpenbare—Det som er født av kjød er kjød; og det som er født av Ånd er ånd – Johannes 3:6.

I dag forsøker vi å skjule oss bak vårt kjød (vår ufornyede menneskelige natur). Vi er flinke til å legge skylden for våre mangler på at vi er i kjød; noen går så langt som å si at vi alle er syndere og derfor ikke kan gjøre annet enn å feile. Men her sier Jesus at det som er kjød er kjød, og det som er ånd er ånd! Å, at vi kunne gripe enkelheten i disse dype ordene! Kjød er kjød, ikke ånd. Og ånd er ånd, ikke kjød. Vi blir født med en adamisk natur (en tilbøyelighet til å gjøre ondt) fra mors liv. Profeten Jeremias forteller oss at Hjertet er bedragersk fremfor alt og ustyrlig; hvem kan kjenne det? – Jeremias 17:9. Han forklarer videre: Jeg, Herren, søker hjertet, jeg gjennomprøver nyrene… – Jeremias 17:10.

Vi kan forsøke, som massene, å temme vår menneskelige natur med alle dens lyster og lidenskaper. Vi kan øve og forberede oss; vi kan stelle kjødet på en måte som virker godt for oss. Men det finnes ingen håp, for i kjødet kan vi ikke behage Gud. Så ifølge Jesus må vi bli født på ny. Nikodemus spør: Hvordan kan en mann bli født når han er gammel? Kan han gå inn på nytt i sin mors liv og bli født? – Johannes 3:4.

Jesus holder så en dyp preken for ham, og sier at det må skje en død …likesom Moses løftet opp slangen i ørkenen, slik må Menneskesønnen bli løftet opp – Johannes 3:14.

Jesus går videre og sier …enhver som gjør det onde, hater lyset og kommer ikke til lyset, for at hans gjerninger ikke skal bli fordømt – Johannes 3:20. Hvis vi først må dø for å bli født på ny, hvordan dør vi? For de som hører Kristus til, har korsfestet kjødet med dets lidenskaper og begjær – Galaterne 5:24. Så hvordan blir en oppriktig søkende person praktisk «født på ny»?

  • For om du med din munn bekjenner Jesus som Herre og i ditt hjerte tror at Gud har oppreist ham fra de døde, skal du bli frelst… – Romerne 10:9-10.
  • Og Peter sa til dem: Omvend dere, og la hver av dere bli døpt i Jesu Kristi navn til syndenes forlatelse; og dere skal få Den Hellige Ånds gave – Apostlenes gjerninger 2:38.
  • …det ord som ble forkynt gagnet dem ikke, fordi det ikke ble blandet med tro hos dem som hørte det – Hebreerne 4:2.
  • Men uten tro er det umulig å behage ham… – Hebreerne 11:6.
  • Og han kom … og forkynte omvendelsens dåp til syndenes forlatelse – Lukas 3:3.
  • Jeg er døren; om noen går inn ved meg, skal han bli frelst… – Johannes 10:9.
  • …Den som vil følge meg, må fornekte seg selv og ta sitt kors opp og følge meg… – Markus 8:34-35.
  • Se, jeg står for døren og banker; om noen hører min røst og åpner døren, vil jeg gå inn til ham og holde måltid med ham og han med meg – Åpenbaringen 3:20.
  • …Og Jesus sa til ham: Du har sett ham, og det er han som taler med deg. Og han sa: Herre, jeg tror. Og han tilbad ham – Johannes 9:35-38.
  • For av nåde er dere frelst ved tro … det er Guds gave: ikke av gjerninger… – Efeserne 2:8-9.

Her ser vi at det finnes forskjellige aspekter ved å bli, å være og å forbli født på ny. Vi har en tro som er full og urokkelig. Vi må ha tro på Bibelens Gud—Den store JEG ER, DEN JEG ER. Vår tro må være synlig for dem rundt oss—vi må ikke holde den skjult. Vi må ikke la menneskefrykt holde vår tro på Gud stille. Vi må begynne å leve i omvendelse. Vi må søke dåp til omvendelse til syndenes forlatelse. Vi må se Jesus som døren—den eneste veien til Gud som vi må gå inn gjennom og så gå i rettferdighet. Vi må se Jesu død på korset som Guds gave til oss for frelsen. Og når vi ser Gud for hvem Han er og Jesus, Hans Sønn, for hvem Han er, da må vi tilbe. Alle disse ting (og andre) er en del av å bli født på ny, eller er utøvelse av det, som fortsetter å opprettholde prosessen med å forbli født på ny.

Skjer det fortsatt ekte omvendelser i vår tid—blir folk født på ny slik Jesus forklarte for Nikodemus? Vi gjør narr av bønnen i billig-nåde-evangeliet, vi ser ned på de maktesløse alterkallene, men hva gjør vi med vårt eget behov? Vi må korsfeste kjødet. Vi må ikke lenger leve for oss selv. Og vi må bli født på ny av Guds Ånd. Etter å ha tilbrakt tid ved Jesu føtter, lært om Ham og Hans Far og Deres veier, må vi så gå ut med Den Hellige Ånds kraft for å dele med fortapte og plagede sjeler hva Gud har gjort for oss. Når folk ser våre liv som er forandret av Gud, vil Han dra de sjeler som søker inn i Hans kjære Søns rike.

Hvis vi virkelig er født på ny, vil vi ha samme vitnesbyrd og lidenskap som disiplene. Vi vil vokse i nåde og forståelse. Vi vil la Gud være Gud og Hans Ord være Sannheten—endelig og fullkommen! Vi vil slutte å forsøke å reformere geitene blant oss. Snarere vil vi dele evangeliets budskap med dem så de kan bli omvendt—da vil de bli får med hjerter av kjød i stedet for hjerter av stein. Et nytt hjerte vil jeg gi dere, og en ny ånd vil jeg sette i dere; og jeg vil ta bort steinhjertet ut av deres kjød og gi dere et hjert av kjød. Og jeg vil sette min ånd i dere og få dere til å vandre i mine lover, så dere skal holde mine dommer og gjøre dem – Esekiel 36:26-27.

Så hvorfor er det mangel på virkelig fødte-på-ny-troende blant oss? Jeg tror denne verden har fanget oss. Vi søker kompromiss der vi kan. Visst, vi vil kle oss litt annerledes om vi må, men ta ikke bort all vår glede og moro. Vi fyller våre liv med alt denne syndssyke verden har å tilby—penger, underholdning, luksus, ferier, mat og drikke, og så når vi går forbi jordet med skatten gjemt i, legger vi ikke engang merke til det. Det er der, enkelt glemt.

Når vi synger Sions sanger og ber bønner om bønn og lovprisning, virker Gud da? Er det en evig glede i våre hjerter eller blir vi kastet omkring av livets stormer? Prøver vi å hjelpe de blinde til å se, eller forsøker vi å skjule at vi er kristne?!

La oss få slutt på dette beseirede kristne livet som kjenner lite av seier. La oss få slutt på det lunkenlivet som massene rundt oss aksepterer! La oss få slutt på å elske denne nåværende onde verden! La oss få slutt på individualisme og selvet! La oss ikle oss Herren Jesus Kristus og sammen marsjere ut i kamp mot sjelens fiende. Nok av bare å sitte hjemme og synge sangene; la oss gå ut og kjempe for det så mange før oss har kjempet for. Vi leser om det i våre kirkens historiebøker. Vi henter oppmuntring og innsikt fra våre Bibler og våre eksemplarer av Martyrs Mirror. Men hva vil kommende generasjoner si om oss? Vil det bli noen fromme vitnesbyrd skrevet om oss?

Bibelen er full av løfter:

  • Bed, så skal det bli gitt dere; let, så skal dere finne; bank på, så skal det bli åpnet for dere… – Matteus 7:7-8.
  • …Gud … skal ikke tillate at dere blir fristet over det dere makter; men med fristelsen vil han også gjøre en utvei, så dere kan holde ut den – 1 Korinter 10:13.
  • …Om dere har tro og ikke tviler … skal dere si til dette fjellet: Bli flyttet og kastet i havet! Og det skal skje – Matteus 21:21.
  • Dette sier jeg da: Vandrer i Ånden, så skal dere ikke fullføre kjødets begjær – Galaterne 5:16.

Og listen fortsetter! Er disse en del av våre liv? Lever vi i seier, eller skjuler vi oss bak en mislykket kultur uten kraft?

Kjære, Gud vil ha et folk å kalle sitt i dag like mye som han gjorde i begynnelsen. Han vil ha oss! Det er en alvorlig tanke. Gud ønsker å reise oss opp ved sin Ånd, han vil blåse sin pust—Livets Ånd—i oss. Han vil velsigne oss med åndelige velsignelser som ikke kan forstås!

Men den gamle mannen må dø—hans stolthet, hans navn, hans holdning, hans berømmelse. Den gamle mannen må gi vei for den nye; de kan ikke leve sammen i samme kropp. Ifølge Skriften er det enten det ene eller det andre. Den ene vil dø, og den andre vil leve—for evig!

La oss ikke la slangen (eller djevelen) bedra oss lenger. Livets gleder er bare for et øyeblikk. Vi høster det vi sår; vi unnslipper ikke domen. Gud vil gi oss riket; han vil gi oss arven. Han vil være en far for oss, kalle oss sine kjære barn. Han vil vandre med oss på denne smale vei. Han vil oppmuntre oss når vi er nede, og han vil kjempe for oss når vi er svake. Han vil gi oss en identitet, en del av Guds familie—hans barn. Han vil gi oss kraft til å overvinne all synd (ikke bare noe), i dag og i morgen og for resten av vårt liv. Når vi feiler, vil han gi oss et ønske om å omvende oss. Så når vi tar imot det ønske og vender tilbake mot ham, vil han tilgi oss.

Jo mørkere denne verden blir, desto klarere bør lyset skinne. Er vi, gjennom Ånden, det fyrtårnet som står høyt i stormen? Vinden og bølgene slår mot det, men det kan ikke flyttes. Dets lys skinner gjennom de mørkeste tider og gir håp til de trette sjeler strandet i livet. Dets grunnvoll rikker ikke; dets hensikt forandrer seg ikke.

Vi kan fylle hodene våre med kunnskap og vite alle de rette ting å si og gjøre. Men hvis vi ikke blir levende ved Guds Ånd, er vi bare en kultur som vil endre seg med hver generasjon. Denne forandringen vil fortsette til den siste generasjonen er fullstendig druknet i denne verdens hav. Samtidig vinner ødeleggeren av våre sjeler mer for seg selv.

Denne kampen er virkelig—noen vil vinne, mange vil tape. Tapet er stort, større enn jeg kan beskrive; og slik er også seieren.

Tjueførste århundrets kristne, hva vil du gjøre?

Greetings to one and all in our dear Saviour’s name, Jesus Christ. Another year has passed from the present into the annals of history. Nothing that we have said or done can be recalled and re-lived. Another year is before us. Many are waiting with bated breath, anticipating what this new year will bring forth.

I read somewhere in the news that those on the frontier of technology believe that this year will be a big year for artificial intelligence. One example given was: they are anticipating that this technology will be able to be a part of events such as board meetings with the ability to hear and understand all that is shared by each one present. Then at the end of the meeting, with the push of a button, the artificial intelligence will produce detailed minutes of that meeting with a fair degree of accuracy. Over the last number of years, many of the things that used to be considered science fiction have recently become reality, so, likely, this will become a new reality as well.

What is this world coming to? To the Bible-literate Christian, the end of time certainly seems to be fast approaching. According to the United Nations, the world’s population surpassed 8 billion on November 15, 2022. Many in the world are desperately trying to figure out how to sustain that many people for the long term. Just like the Bible has prophesied, there is an uptick in the number of famines, drought, floods, earthquakes, wars, and rumors of wars, etc. One thing that I find interesting is that even though the world does not want to retain God in their knowledge, insurance companies still refer to certain specific events as “acts of God”.

As Bible-believing Christians how shall we then live? And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet –Matthew 24:6. Let us remember that we should not be troubled. Rather, we should remember that …he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved –Matthew 24:13. If we, like Peter, take our eyes off of our Lord and start focusing on the stormy conditions around us we will start to sink as well. Remember, it is …the fearful, and unbelieving … [who] shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone… –Revelation 21:8. But, He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son –Revelation 21:7.

In this issue of the magazine, we again have an interesting group of articles for your consideration. Join us as we learn of a somewhat obscure, yet influential leader of the early Anabaptist movement in Switzerland. Let’s honestly evaluate our own hearts as we follow the expository teaching from Habakkuk regarding what it means to have a real faith that is first personal, then corporate. Together we can consider what it really means to enter into the rest of God that is detailed in Hebrews chapter four. The youth can take a look into their emotions as they consider those times when they feel like giving up. The author for our sisters’ article has tackled a very difficult subject—when and how to be submissive as a godly wife. We have another thought-provoking article in the discipleship series. And the doctor has chosen to venture into some uncharted territory with the first of a two-part series on cancer.

A final thought I wish to share, a story in fact… Recently, I heard a first-hand account of a man who was lost before God, how he came to spiritual awakening, and how this started affecting his life. This story caused me to stop and consider where I am as a Christian. Is my relationship with my Lord vibrant? How strong is my commitment towards God and His Word? Is my love for my Lord and Saviour still as real and as strong as it was when I first had my awakening and was converted? I’m sure there are more questions that we could ask ourselves in light of this real-life story. I’ll let you as a reader start compiling your own list. Now for the story…

This man is living somewhere within the United States of America. He is a married man with a young family. He is part of a certain religious group within the plain people—those of Anabaptist heritage. Throughout his lifetime he had endeavored to live his life according to the mandates set forth by the leaders of his local church. Yet, for some reason, he had not been finding answers to his personal need, whatever that was—perhaps even he didn’t know.

This man and some of his family were traveling and ended up lodging overnight in a motel. There, in the nightstand drawer he discovered a book titled “The Holy Bible”. Sure, in his church the Bible was read or quoted each week during their normal worship services. Although this man understood English quite well, his church had a policy that they did not want to be too worldly or too modern by reading from an English Bible so they continued their efforts of teaching God’s Word using the original language of their people.

The problem was that this man, somehow, never developed an understanding of that language, thus he never heard the truth of God’s Word. All that he heard was what 1 Corinthians chapter 14 refers to as tongues (languages) and since he didn’t understand the language and since there was no interpretation given, he was not able to be edified. The purpose of this story is not to find fault or to place blame, but rather to bring light to an obvious problem among some of the plain people. A problem for which God would surely desire to see changes made for the betterment of those seeking Him in such settings.

With this in mind, we now come back to this man—a man zealous in his religious life—yet having NEVER heard the message of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. As he hesitantly picked up this English Bible he cautiously started to read the message contained within those book covers. As he read, he became more and more excited. Here were things that he had never heard before—teachings that brought sense to his many questions and the emptiness that he felt within his soul. He was so engrossed that he almost couldn’t pull himself away to allow time for sleep. After a short night, they went on with their travels.

Completing their business they returned home, but life would never be the same for that man. Something had been awakened deep within his soul. Questions had been answered. Longings had been met. Peace had begun to settle over his troubled heart. At long last, he had found the answer, but his time of reading had been so short. Surely there was more to learn, much more. So, before too much time had elapsed, he once more scheduled a trip to get away from his local area and to once more provide a reason to spend another night in a motel with a Bible in the nightstand drawer. He eagerly anticipated another night alone with God and His Word. After a second sleepless night spent devouring the teachings of the Scriptures, he started seeking others who understood and practiced what the Bible said. He was desiring to fellowship and learn all that he could from those who understood God’s Word and who practiced what they preached.

As this man has endeavored to find his way through this confusing maze of religious idiosyncrasies he finally purchased a German/English Bible. He felt driven in his continued pursuit of the Truth, yet he was afraid to be found out by his local church leaders. He wanted to stay within his local church, yet his conscience demanded that he must continue his search. For some reason he believed that his local church leaders would not be understanding in his quest for truth and that maybe he would be placed under church discipline for his actions.

His local church is a part of the descendants of the Anabaptists who were persecuted for their faith, including their desire to understand, and read the Scriptures in their native tongue—Swiss or German, instead of Latin as was required by the church leaders of their day. Yet here he is, some 500 years later, in America, possibly facing persecution from his own church which claims to be a part of the “right” church of God. Herein, his church leaders are finding themselves on the opposite side of the issue of freedom of religious worship that their forefathers suffered for, since they are insisting that the only way to learn of God’s will is through the official language of Scripture—German. This is NO different than the struggle of the original Anabaptists who were persecuted for not studying the Scriptures in the official language of their day—Latin.

Let’s remember, IF church members do not understand the teachings of God’s Word due to their church leaders’ stubborn insistence that the church members are NOT allowed to read or hear the Scriptures in the language that they understand, then the ignorance of the common man WILL be laid at the feet of those leaders come judgment day. Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account… –Hebrews 13:17. Obey here is only in the context of God’s Word, not just according to church leaders’ personal ideas or whims. For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad –2 Corinthians 5:10. Every person will receive personal judgment based on what the Bible teaches NOT according to a church’s detailed dogma.

When I think of the zealous efforts of this man I think of the verse of Scripture… When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel –Matthew 8:10. I also observe the current trends of some of our plain publishing houses—they have borrowed from the world’s idea (in a spiritual way, of course) that to sell books and reading material they need to print exhilarating stories, ones that keep people on the edge of their seats—all this because today’s Christian has become bored with that which seems old-fashioned.

What a difference between this story and many of today’s Anabaptist descendants. Many of today’s conservative Anabaptist people have a difficult time getting excited about the Bible. They are too over-stimulated by the lack of rest and quiet in their normal daily lives.

Usually, we hear of stories like this from the jungles of Central America, the deserts of Africa, or the slums of India. What I am amazed about is that this story takes place right in the midst of one of our plain groups of conservative Anabaptists. Let’s seek God for opportunities to share the truth of the Gospel message with those within the sphere of our influence. We might be surprised how many people we rub shoulders with during our daily lives who would be just as hungry for the Truth as the man in our story.

ברכות לכל ואחת בשם מושיענו היקר, ישוע המשיח. עוד שנה עברה מן ההווה אל כרוניקות ההיסטוריה. כל מה שאמרנו או עשינו אינו ניתן לזכור ולחיות מחדש. לפנינו עוד שנה. רבים ממתינים בנשימה עצורה, צופים מה תביא עימה שנה זו.

קראתי אי־שם בחדשות שאילו נמצא בחזית הטכנולוגיה מאמינים כי זו תהיה שנה גדולה לבינה מלאכותית. דוגמה שניתנה: הם צופים שהטכנולוגיה תוכל להשתתף באירועים כגון ישיבות הנהלה עם היכולת לשמוע ולהבין כל מה שמשותף על־ידי כל משתתף. ואז בסוף הישיבה, בלחיצת כפתור, הבינה המלאכותית תפיק פרוטוקול מפורט של אותה ישיבה עם מידת דיוק סבירה. בשנים האחרונות, הרבה מהדברים שבעבר נחשבו למדע־בדיוני הפכו לאחרונה למציאות, ולכן סביר להניח שגם זה יהפוך למציאות חדשה.

לאן העולם הזה הולך? לנוצרי שכתובית התנ"ך עומדת מול עיניו, נראה שהקץ בהחלט מתקרב במהירות. לפי האו"ם, אוכלוסיית העולם עלתה על 8 מיליארד ב־15 בנובמבר 2022. רבים בעולם מנסים בייאוש להבין איך לקיים מספר כה גדול של אנשים לטווח הארוך. כפי שהתנ"ך חזה, יש עלייה במספר הרעבונות, בצורות, בשיטפונות, ברעידות אדמה, במלחמות ובשמועות על מלחמות וכו'. דבר אחד שמעניין אותי הוא שלאחרים מקשים שלא לשמור את אלוהים בידעם, חברות הביטוח עדיין מתייחסות לאירועים מסוימים כ"מעשי האל".

כיצד עלינו לחיות כמאמינים שמאמינים בתנ"ך? ושמעו לכם מלחמות ושמועות מלחמות; ראו אל תטרדו כי כל אלה חייבים להיות; אך קץ עוד לא עכשיו –Matthew 24:6. נחזור ונזכור שלא עלינו להטרד. במקום זאת עלינו לזכור ש:…והמתמיד עד קץ הוא יושיע –Matthew 24:13. אם אנו, כמו פטרוס, נוריד את עינינו מן האדון ונתחיל להתמקד בתנאים הסוערים סביבנו, גם אנחנו נתחיל לשקוע. זכרו, אלה הֵמָּה …הפחדנים והאפיסת־האמונה … [שתהיה להם] חלק האגם השרוף באש ובגופרית… –Revelation 21:8. אך, המנצח יירש הכל ואני אהיה אלהיו והוא יהיה בני –Revelation 21:7.

במהדורה זו של המגזין יש לנו שוב אוסף מעניין של מאמרים לשקולכם. הצטרפו אלינו כאשר נלמד על מנהיג מעט מוכר, אך משפיע, בתנועת האנבפטיסטים המוקדמת בשווייץ. נבחן ביושר את לבבנו כאשר נעקוב אחרי ההוראה הפרשנית מתוך חבקוק לגבי מה זה אמונה אמיתית שהיא תחילה אישית, ואחר כך קהילתית. יחד נוכל לשקול מה באמת פירושו להיכנס למנוחת אלוהים המתוארת בפרק ד' של העברים. הצעירים יכולים לבחון את רגשותיהם כשהם שוקלים את אותם זמנים שבהם הם מרגישים כמזניחים. המחברת לכותבת לשותפותיה נטלה על עצמה נושא קשה מאוד—מתי וכיצד להיות צייתנית כאישה נבונה. יש לנו מאמר נוסף שמעורר מחשבה בסדרת ההתחנכות. והרופא בחר לצאת אל שטחים לא מוכרים עם החלק הראשון של סדרת שני חלקים על סרטן.

מחשבה אחרונה שאני רוצה לחלוק, למעשה סיפור… לאחרונה שמעתי תיאור ממקור ראשון של איש שהיה אבוד לפני האלוהים, כיצד הגיע להתעוררות רוחנית, וכיצד זה התחיל להשפיע על חייו. סיפור זה הכריח אותי לעצור ולבחון היכן אני כמאמין? האם יחסיי עם אדוני תוססים? כמה חזקה מחויבותי כלפי אלוהים ודברו? האם אהבתי לאדוני ולמושיעי עדיין אמיתית וחזקה כפי שהיתה כשראשית התעוררותי וההפיכה שלי? בטוח שיש עוד שאלות שנוכל לשאול את עצמנו לאור סיפור מהחיים האמיתיים הזה. אתן לכם כקוראים להתחיל להרכיב את רשימתכם. וכעת הסיפור…

האיש הזה חי אי־שם בתוך ארצות הברית של אמריקה. הוא איש נשוי עם משפחה צעירה. הוא שייך לקבוצה דתית מסוימת בתוך העם הפשוט—מוצא האנבפטיסטי. במשך חייו נשא במאמצים לנהל חיי־דין לפי המנדטים שקבעו מנהיגי קהילתו המקומית. ועדיין, מסיבה כלשהי, הוא לא מצא מענה לצורך האישי שלו, מה שהוא שלא היה יכול אפילו לדעת מהו.

האיש הזה וחלק מבני משפחתו נסעו והתגוררו לילה במלון. שם, במגירת השידת־הלילה, גילה ספר שכותרתו "הכתובים הקדושים". כמובן, בכנסייתו קראו או ציטטו את התנ"ך בכל שבוע במהלך שירותי הער worship הרגילים שלהם. למרות שאיש זה הבין אנגלית די טוב, בכנסייתו הייתה מדיניות שאינה רוצה להיות יותר מדי עולמית או מודרנית על־ידי קריאה מתוך תנ"ך באנגלית, ולכן הם המשיכו במאמציהם ללמד את דבר ה' בשפת המוצא של העם שלהם.

הבעיה הייתה שאיש זה, איכשהו, מעולם לא פיתח הבנה של אותה שפה, ולכן הוא מעולם לא שמע את אמת דבר ה'. כל מה ששמע היה מה שפרק א' לקורינתים י"ז מכנה שפות (לשונות), ומכיוון שהוא לא הבין את השפה וממילא לא ניתן לו פירוש, הוא לא היה מעודד. מטרת הסיפור הזה איננה למצוא אשמה או להטיל קלון, אלא להאיר בעיה ברורה בקרב חלק מהעם הפשוט. בעיה שבהודאות היו רוצים שה' יראה שינויים לטובה לטובת אלה המחפשים אותו בהקשרים כאלה.

עם זאת, אנו חוזרים לאיש הזה—איש קדוש בחייו הדתיים—ולמרות זאת שמע מעולם לא את בשורת ישוע המשיח. כשהרים בזהירות את התנ"ך האנגלי הזה החל לקרוא בזהירות את המסר הכלול בין כריכיו. ככל שקרא, התרגש יותר ויותר. הנה דברים שמעולם לא שמע קודם—תורות שענו על שאלותיו הרבות ועל הריק פנימי שחש בנפשו. הוא התעמק כל כך עד שכמעט לא הצליח להניח את הספר כדי להניח זמן לשינה. לאחר לילה קצר, המשיכו בדרכם.

כשהשלימו את עסקיהם חזרו הביתה, אך החיים עבור אותו איש לעולם לא היו כפי שהיו. משהו התעוור עמוק בנפשו. שאלות נענו. תשוקות נמתחו. שלום החל לשכון על לבו הסוער. סוף־סוף מצא את התשובה, אך זמן הקריאה שלו היה קצר. בוודאי שיש עוד ללמוד, הרבה יותר. אז, לפני שהשבועות עברו, קבע שוב נסיעה להתרחק מאזורו המקומי וכדי לספק סיבה נוספת לבלות לילה נוסף במלון עם תנ"ך במגירת השידה. הוא ציפה בסקרנות לעוד לילה בודד עם אלוהים ודברו. לאחר לילה שני ללא שינה בלע את תורת הכתובים והחל לחפש אחרים שהבינו ועמדו במה שהתנ"ך אמר. הוא שאף להתחבר וללמוד ככל שביכולתו מאלה שהבינו את דבר ה' ומעשיהם בהתאם.

בעוד איש זה נחוש למצוא את דרכו בתוך המבוך המבלבל של מוזרויות דתיות, הוא בסופו של דבר רכש תנ"ך דו־לשוני גרמנית/אנגלית. הוא הרגיש דחף בהמשך מרדפו אחרי האמת, אך פחד שמנהיגי כנסייתו המקומית יגלו אותו. הוא רצה להישאר בכנסייתו המקומית, אך מצפונו דרש שימשיך בחיפושים. מסיבה כלשהי האמין שמנהיגי כנסייתו המקומית לא יהיו מבינים בחיפושו אחר האמת ושאולי יוטלו עליו משמעת כנסייתית על מעשיו.

כנסייתו המקומית היא חלק מצאצאי האנבפטיסטים שנרדפו על אמונתם, כולל רצונם להבין ולקרוא את הכתובים בשפת מולדתם—שווייצרית או גרמנית, במקום הלטינית שנדרשה על־ידי מנהיגי הכנסייה בימיהם. ובכל זאת הנה הוא, כ־500 שנה מאוחר יותר, באמריקה, אולי ניצב בפני רדיפה מכנסייתו שלו הטוענת שהיא חלק מהכנסייה ה"נכונה" של אלוהים. כאן מנהיגי כנסייתו מוצאים את עצמם בצד הנגדי של סוגיית חירות הפולחן הדתי שלשמו סבלו אבותיהם, שכן הם מתעקשים שהדרך היחידה ללמוד את רצון ה' היא דרך שפת הרשמית של הכתובים—גרמנית. זה אינו שונה מהמאבק של האנבפטיסטים המקוריים שנרדפו על שלא למדו את הכתובים בשפתם הרשמית של אותם ימים—לטינית.

נזכור, אם אנשי הכנסייה אינם מבינים את תורת דבר ה' בשל עקשנות מנהיגיהם שמתעקשים שאנשי הכנסייה אינם מורשים לקרוא או לשמוע את הכתובים בשפה שהם מבינים, אז בורות האדם הפשוט תונח יום הדין לרגלי אותם מנהיגים. שמעו להם שישלטו בכם והכניעו להם; כי הם שומרים על נפשותיכם, כתמורה לכך שהם יתנו דין… –Hebrews 13:17. הצייתנות כאן היא אך ורק בהקשר של דבר ה', לא רק לפי רעיונותיהם האישיים או גחמותיהם של מנהיגי הכנסייה. כי על כסא המשפט של המשיח כולנו נטעם, שאיש ואיש יקבל את שכרו לפי גופו מה שעשה אם טוב או רע –2 Corinthians 5:10. כל אדם יקבל דין אישי על פי מה שהתנ"ך מלמד ולא לפי דוקטרינה מפורטת של כנסייה.

כשאני חושב על מאמציו הקנאים של האיש הזה עולה בלבי הפסוק… וישוע כשמע זה התמה והאמר לממלאיו, באמת אמר אני לכם, אף במזרח לא מצאתי אמונה כה רבה –Matthew 8:10. אני גם מבחין במגמות הנוכחיות של חלק מבתי ההוצאה של העם הפשוט—הם שאבו מרעיון העולם (ברוחניות, כמובן) שכדי למכור ספרים וחומרי קריאה עליהם להדפיס סיפורים מרתקים, כאלה שמשאירים את הקורא על קצה כסאו—כל זאת מפני שהנוצרי של היום שואל הרבה מהנראה כמיושן.

איזו הבדלה בין הסיפור הזה לבין רבים מצאצאי האנבפטיסטים של היום. רבים מהאינבפטיסטים השמרנים של היום מתקשים להתרגש מן התנ"ך. הם רוויים מדי בחוסר המנוחה והשקט שבחיי היומיום שלהם.

בדרך כלל שומעים סיפורים כאלה מהג'ונגלים של אמריקה המרכזית, המדבריות של אפריקה או העוני של הודו. המדהים לי הוא שסיפור זה מתרחש בלב אחת מקבוצות העם הפשוט של האנבפטיסטים השמרנים שלנו. נשאף אל ה' להזדמנויות לשתף את אמת בשורת הבשורה עם אלה שבתחום השפעתנו. נופתע כמה אנשים שאנו נתקלים בהם בחיי היומיום יהיו רעבים לאמת בדיוק כמו האיש שבסיפורנו.

As a child, you might think you can’t make a difference in the lives of people around you, but that is not true! Your little acts of kindness will not soon be forgotten. Being a true friend to someone who is hurting can change that person’s life forever.

This is the true story of “Hadassah” (not her real name) a young girl who was very much looking forward to starting school. Once she started first grade, what a disappointment it was to find that the second-grade girls were ready for someone to be mean to, or so it seemed. Maybe it would have been better if Hadassah had stood up to them, but she didn’t. Instead, she chose to act as if it didn’t hurt and tried to ignore them. Some days were better than others, but sadly this went on for three or four years.

Sure, there were good times too, but many evenings she walked home from school, crying most of the way and wishing that she wouldn’t need to go back to school the next day!

One day, one of the girls lost her pen. She was sure that Hadassah had stolen it. This was very disturbing to a very conscientious Hadassah. At the next recess she was blamed for cheating on her flash cards. Many other made-up stories were also passed around among the girls.

However, there was one little girl in that second-grade group of girls whose name we’ll say was “Esther”. She was Hadassah’s best friend and supported her all through those difficult years.

Esther was a very gentle, sweet girl, which is mostly what Hadassah remembered her for. Esther had cystic fibrosis and in the 1970s they didn’t have as many treatment options available for that disease as they do now, so those patients usually died very young. As Esther’s sickness became worse, the days that she felt well enough to be in school were rare. Since Esther was well-liked, the days when she was in school were special to everyone. Perhaps Esther realized she would be in heaven before the other girls—we don’t know for sure. But she taught the girls a song, “How Far Is Heaven”, which Hadassah still likes to sing today!

Hadassah still remembers seeing the emergency squad go past her house when they took Esther to the hospital for the last time. It was a very sad group of schoolgirls when Esther died at the age of 13. Esther had touched the hearts of many people in her short life, including the nurses who had cared for her during her stay in the hospital. Hadassah still remembers seeing some of the nurses crying at Esther’s funeral. Do you think Hadassah will ever forget Esther? Never!

Besides being her best friend, another bright spot for Hadassah was that when Esther was in school the other girls weren’t as mean to her (Hadassah). It so happened that in about the fourth grade, Esther was in school more often. One day she went home and told her parents what she was witnessing in school—how the other girls were against Hadassah and were being so mean to her. Esther’s father brought this problem up in the next parent/teacher meeting. What a night and day change started the very next day! One of the girls even came to Hadassah and apologized. Finally, they could all be friends and today those girls are Hadassah’s “old school friends”.

It’s worth it to stand beside someone who is being treated unkindly. Your support may be what God uses to help your friend to go through their hard times in a good way! And share it with your parents, they can help find a way to change the problem.

एक बच्चा होने के नाते, आप सोच सकते हैं कि आप अपने आसपास के लोगों के जीवन में फर्क नहीं ला सकते — पर यह सच नहीं है! आपकी छोटी-छोटी दयालुता की क्रियाएँ जल्द ही भुला दी जाएँगी, यह जरूरी नहीं। किसी पीड़ित व्यक्ति की सच्ची मित्र बनना उस व्यक्ति के जीवन को हमेशा के लिए बदल सकता है।

यह कहानी “Hadassah” (यह उसका असली नाम नहीं है) नामक एक युवती की असली कहानी है, जो स्कूल शुरू करने के लिए बहुत उत्साहित थी। पहली कक्षा शुरू करने के बाद, यह कितनी निराशा की बात थी कि दूसरी कक्षा की लड़कियाँ किसी पर बुरा व्यवहार करने के लिए तैयार दिखाई देती थीं। शायद बेहतर होता अगर Hadassah ने उनका सामना किया होता, पर उसने ऐसा नहीं किया। इसके बजाय उसने ऐसा अभिनय किया कि उसे चोट नहीं पहुंची और उन्हें अनदेखा करने की कोशिश की। कुछ दिन बेहतर थे, पर दुख की बात यह है कि यह तीन या चार साल तक चलता रहा।

निश्चित ही, अच्छे समय भी थे, पर कई शामें ऐसी थीं जब वह स्कूल से रोते हुए घर जाती और रास्ते का अधिकांश भाग रोती रहती और चाहती कि अगला दिन स्कूल न जाना पड़े!

एक दिन, उन लड़कियों में से एक ने अपना पेन खो दिया। वह सुनिश्चित थी कि पेन Hadassah ने चुरा लिया है। यह बहुत ईमानदार Hadassah के लिए बहुत परेशान करने वाला था। अगली छुट्टी के समय उसे फ्लैश कार्ड्स पर धोखाधड़ी करने का आरोप लगाया गया। बहुत सी अन्य रची गई कहानियाँ भी लड़कियों के बीच घुमाईं गईं।

हालाँकि, उन दूसरी कक्षा की लड़कियों में एक छोटी लड़की थी जिसका नाम हम “Esther” कहेंगे। वह Hadassah की सबसे अच्छी दोस्त थी और उन कठिन वर्षों में उसका साथ देती रही।

Esther बहुत नरम-सुभाषित, प्यारी लड़की थी—यही वह मुख्य बात थी जिसके लिए Hadassah उसे याद करती है। Esther को सिस्टिक फाइब्रोसिस थी और 1970 के दशक में उस बीमारी के लिए आज जितने इलाज उपलब्ध नहीं थे, इसलिए ऐसे रोगियों की आमतौर पर कम उम्र में मृत्यु हो जाती थी। जैसे-जैसे Esther की बीमारी खराब हुई, स्कूल में रहने के लिए जिस दिन वह ठीक महसूस करती वह दुर्लभ हो गए। चूँकि Esther को लोग पसंद करते थे, जब वह स्कूल में होती तो वे दिन सभी के लिए खास होते। शायद Esther ने महसूस किया होगा कि वह दूसरी लड़कियों से पहले स्वर्ग में होगी—हम निश्चित रूप से नहीं जानते। पर उसने लड़कियों को एक गीत सिखाया, "स्वर्ग कितना दूर है", जिसे Hadassah आज भी गाना पसंद करती है!

Hadassah को आज भी याद है कि जब उन्होंने Esther को अंतिम बार अस्पताल ले जाते हुए आपातकालीन वाहन को उसके घर के पास से जाते देखा था। जब Esther की 13 वर्ष की आयु में मृत्यु हुई तो वह बहुत उदास स्कूलगर्ल्स का समूह था। Esther ने अपने छोटे जीवन में कई लोगों के दिलों को छुआ था, जिनमें वे नर्सें भी शामिल थीं जिन्होंने उसके अस्पताल में रहने के दौरान उसकी देखभाल की थी। Hadassah को आज भी याद है कि कुछ नर्सों को Esther की अंतिम संस्कार में रोते देखा गया था। क्या आपको लगता है कि Hadassah Esther को कभी भुला देगी? कभी नहीं!

अपनी सबसे अच्छी दोस्त होने के अलावा, Hadassah के लिए एक और उजला पक्ष यह था कि जब Esther स्कूल में होती तो दूसरी लड़कियाँ (Hadassah के प्रति) इतनी कठोर नहीं होतीं। ऐसा हुआ कि चौथी कक्षा के आस-पास, Esther स्कूल में अधिक समय तक रहती। एक दिन वह घर गई और उसने अपने माता-पिता को बताया कि वह स्कूल में क्या देख रही थी—कैसे दूसरी लड़कियाँ Hadassah के खिलाफ थीं और उसके साथ इतनी बुरी तरह पेश आ रही थीं। Esther के पिता ने अगले अभिभावक/शिक्षक बैठक में इस समस्या को उठाया। अगले ही दिन से दिन-रात जैसा बदलाव आ गया! उन लड़कियों में से एक ने तो Hadassah के पास आकर माफ़ी भी माँगी। आखिरकार, वे सब दोस्त बन सके और आज वे लड़कियाँ Hadassah की "पुरानी स्कूल दोस्त" हैं।

किसी के साथ खड़े होना जो अनदर्शनीय तरीके से व्यवहार किया जा रहा है, यह सार्थक होता है। आपका समर्थन वह चीज़ हो सकती है जिसका परमेश्वर उपयोग कर आपके मित्र को मुश्किल समय को अच्छी तरह से पार करने में मदद करे! और इसे अपने माता-पिता के साथ साझा करें, वे इस समस्या को बदलने का कोई तरीका ढूँढ़ने में मदद कर सकते हैं।

Over the last number of years, we have spent much of our time in Haiti serving on the mission field. From time to time, we would return to America for visits of varying lengths and reasons. Each trip back to the U.S. has been challenging as we have observed the changes—changes in culture, in technology, in values, etc. Sometimes, as our family looks at our country, it seems as if there is little hope. Clearly evil is taking control. However, to me the change that seems to be the most concerning is that of the church. Most, if not all, God-fearing Christians clearly see the moral decline of our land, but what about our churches? Is the church holding firm to biblical teaching or is it following the world in gradual change and compromise?

Overall, the American church seems to be thriving financially. Our businesses are improving, along with our standard of living, while spiritually, many Christians seem to be losing their zeal for godliness. What will the church look like in 40, 50, or 80 years?

When we read the book of Acts, we see something over and over. God’s power is revealed, and souls are added to the kingdom—daily.

Usually, when people see something that they need, they go after it. When they see something that they are sure that they must have, they can even become desperate or radical as they pursue a way to get that thing.

Jesus tells the parable of a field containing a lost or hidden treasure—Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field –Matthew 13:44.

Here you have a man that may be satisfied with his life. He has possessions and good health. As he is walking home, he sees something that he has never seen before, something of great value, something that he must have. No one needed to force him to take action. Also, it didn’t take days or weeks before he acted—he saw it and decided that he must have it immediately. So, he went and sold all that he had. (Selling ‘most’ would not buy the field. No, he must sell all.) After he buys the field, he now possesses the most important thing in the world. He will keep it forever, he will never part with it, no matter the cost. He also realizes that this treasure is not only good for him, but for all mankind. In fact, he soon understands that if he does not find this treasure, then sell all that he has, and purchase the treasure, he will perish—forever. People around him may not understand him—his actions, his decisions, his moves—they may be confused at first, as to why he did what he did. However, they will not be confused about one thing—this treasure was worth all the world to this man. His love for it cannot be denied.

This man now possesses something within himself out of which flows love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance… –Galatians 5:22-23, which is the fruit of the Spirit. He seems to have a special power about him. He overcomes suffering and difficulties with ease—at least that’s how it appears to those looking on. He holds no grudges and loves even his enemies. Truly this man has found something for which it is worth selling all. Then, lo and behold, others begin to sell what they have, to possess this treasure for themselves also.

According to the Bible, God’s people are expected to be the light of the world and the salt of the earth. Let’s seriously and honestly ask ourselves this question: “Do those around us experience us as biblical light and salt?!”

During the time of the Acts of the Apostles, there were clear lines, and the church grew. Yes, it suffered; however, it still grew, at times daily.

As I travel to different communities, I see something that is hard to understand. There are certain groups of people that seem to look different from the world around them, but still, they seem to act the same as mainstream America. Their interests are the same; their desires are the same. I have wondered why they continue to look different from the world while they seem to have the same values.

I was in a grocery store when a woman that I had never seen before approached me. She was very cheerful and asked me some random questions, then before she left, she said, “I love you Mennonites; you are so cute!” It was heart-breaking—we did not cause conviction in her heart. We did not even set an example for her. Instead, we were simply entertaining her.

In Haiti, my family would walk into a church or a spiritual gathering, and the ladies would pull at their miniskirts, trying desperately to cover their nakedness. I’ve even seen some remove their jewelry, without us speaking a word! Light exposes darkness: it brings conviction. That is why Christians used to be hated by those around them.

So why are we a cultural display to the world? What has changed? Could it be that we are simply reproducing the cultural norms that the world holds dear? Are we leaving God out, while we continue to do the things this world has come to accept?

When Nicodemus came to Jesus, he instantly began to lift up the Lord saying …we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him –John 3:2.

However, Jesus seems to ignore these words and He cuts right to the chase, when He says: …Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God –John 3:3. It’s almost as if He was saying, [“Although you come seeking, you seem to possess some truth, and you are a ruler of the Jews, but the first thing that you must know is this: You must be born again.”] Powerful words. He then goes on to state the obvious—That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit –John 3:6.

Today we try to hide behind our flesh (our unregenerated human nature). We are good at blaming our shortcomings on the fact that we are in the flesh; some go as far as to say we are all sinners and therefore, we can do nothing but fail. However, here Jesus says that that which is flesh is flesh, and that which is spirit is spirit! Oh, that we could grasp the simplicity in these profound words! Flesh is flesh, not spirit. And spirit is spirit, not flesh. We are born with an adamic nature (a bent towards doing evil) from our mother’s womb. The prophet Jeremiah tells us that The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it? –Jeremiah 17:9. He goes on to explain: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins… –Jeremiah 17:10.

We may try, like the masses, to tame our human nature with all of its desires and passions. We may practice and prepare; we can groom the flesh in a certain way that seems good unto us. However, there is no hope, for in the flesh we cannot please God. So, according to Jesus we must be born again. Nicodemus asks: …How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born? –John 3:4.

Jesus then profoundly preaches a sermon to him, stating how there must be death …as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up –John 3:14.

Jesus goes on to say …every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved –John 3:20. If we must first die, to be born again, how do we die? And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts –Galatians 5:24. So how does a sincerely seeking person practically become “born again”?

  • That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved… –Romans 10:9-10.
  • Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost –Acts 2:38.
  • …the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it –Hebrews 4:2.
  • But without faith it is impossible to please him… –Hebrews 11:6.
  • And he came … preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins –Luke 3:3.
  • I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved… –John 10:9.
  • …Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me… –Mark 8:34-35.
  • Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me –Revelation 3:20.
  • …And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee. And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him –John 9:35-38.
  • For by grace are ye saved through faith … it is the gift of God: Not of works… –Ephesians 2:8-9.

Here we see that there are various aspects of becoming, of being, and of remaining born again. We have faith that is full and unwavering. We need to have faith in the God of the Bible—The great I AM, THAT I AM. Our faith must be open to those around us—we must not keep it hidden. We must not allow the fear of man to keep our faith in God quiet. We need to start walking in repentance. We need to seek baptism unto repentance for the remission of sins. We need to see Jesus as the door—the only way to God through which we must enter and then walk in righteousness. We need to see Jesus’ death on the cross as the gift of God to us for salvation. And as we see God for who He is and Jesus, His Son, for who He is, then we must worship. All of these (and others) are a part of becoming born again, or it is the outworking thereof, which continues to perpetuate the process of staying born again.

Are true conversions still happening in our day—are people being born again the way that Jesus was explaining to Nicodemus? We mock the prayer of the cheap-grace gospel, we look down on the powerless altar calls, but what are we doing about our need? We need to crucify the flesh. We need to live no longer unto self. And we need to be born again by the spirit of God. After spending time at the feet of Jesus, learning of Him and His Father and Their ways, we then need to go forth with Holy Spirit power to share with lost and struggling souls what God has done for us. As people see our life that has been changed by God, He will draw the souls that are seeking into the kingdom of His dear Son.

If we are truly born again, we will have the same testimony and passion as the disciples. We will grow in grace and understanding. We will allow God to be God and His Word to be the Truth—final and complete! We will stop trying to reform the goats among us. Rather we will share the Gospel message with them so they can become converted—they will then be sheep with hearts of flesh instead of hearts of stone. A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh. And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them –Ezekiel 36:26-27.

So why is there a lack of truly born-again believers among us? I believe this world has captivated us. We look for compromise wherever we can. Sure, we will dress a little differently if we must, but don’t take away all our pleasure and fun. We fill our lives with everything this sin-sick world has to offer—money, entertainment, luxury, vacations, food, and drink, then when we walk by the field with the treasure hidden in it, we do not even notice it. It’s there, simply forgotten.

When we sing the songs of Zion and pray the prayers of petition and praise, is God at work? Is there an everlasting joy in our hearts or are we tossed about by the storms of life? Are we out trying to help the blind to see or are we trying to conceal the fact that we’re Christians?!

Let’s put an end to this defeated Christian life that knows little of victory. Let’s put an end to the lukewarm living that’s accepted by the masses around us! Let’s put an end to loving this present evil world! Let’s put an end to individualism and self! Let’s put on the Lord Jesus Christ and together march out to battle against the enemy of our souls. Enough of just sitting at home singing the songs; let’s go out and fight for that which so many before us have fought. We read about it in our church history books. We glean encouragement and insight from our Bibles and our copies of the Martyrs Mirror. But what will future generations say about us? Will there be any godly testimonies written about us?

The Bible is full of promises:

  • Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you… –Matthew 7:7-8.
  • …God … will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it –1 Corinthians 10:13.
  • …If ye have faith, and doubt not … ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done –Matthew 21:21.
  • This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh –Galatians 5:16.

And the list goes on! Are these a part of our lives? Are we living in victory, or are we hiding behind a failed culture with no power?

Dear ones, God wants a people to call His own today just as much as He did in the beginning. He wants us! It is a sobering thought. God wants to raise us up by His Spirit, He wants to breathe into us His breath—the Breath of Life. He wants to bless us with spiritual blessings that cannot be fathomed!

However, the old man must die—his pride, his name, his attitude, his fame. The old man must give way for the new; they cannot live together in the same body. According to scripture, it’s one or the other. One will die, and one will live—forever!

Let’s not allow the serpent (or the devil) to deceive us any longer. The pleasures of this life are only for a moment. We reap what we sow; we will not escape the Judgment. God wants to give us the Kingdom; He wants to give us the inheritance. He wants to be a father to us, to call us His dear children. He wants to walk with us through this narrow way. He wants to encourage us when we are down, and He wants to fight for us when we are weak. He wants to give us an identity, a part of the family of God—His children. He wants to give us power to overcome all sin (not just some), today and tomorrow and for the rest of our life. When we fail, He wants to give us a desire to repent. Then when we accept that desire and move back towards Him, He wants to forgive us.

The darker this world gets, the easier the light should shine. Are we, through the Spirit, that lighthouse standing tall in the face of the storm? The wind and the waves beat against it, but it cannot be moved. Its light shines through the darkest times, giving hope to the weary souls stranded in life. Its foundation does not move; its purpose does not change.

We can fill our heads with knowledge and know all the right things to say and do. However, if we are not quickened by the Spirit of God, we are simply a culture that will change with each generation. This change will continue until the last generation has been fully submerged in the seas of this world. All the while, the destroyer of our souls gains more for himself.

This battle is real—some will win, many will lose. The loss is great, greater than I can describe; and so is the win.

Twenty first century Christian, what will you do?

Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, tumekuwa tukitumia muda mwingi Haiti tukihudumu kwenye uwanja wa misheni. Mara kwa mara, tulirudi Amerika kwa ziara za muda tofauti na sababu mbalimbali. Kila safari ya kurudi Marekani imekuwa changamoto tunapoona mabadiliko—mabadiliko ya tamaduni, teknolojia, maadili, n.k. Wakati mwingine, familia yetu tukitazama nchi yetu, inaonekana kama hakuna tumaini. Bila shaka uovu unapata udhibiti. Hata hivyo, kwangu mabadiliko yanayonishangaza zaidi ni yale ya kanisa. Wakristo wanaomtisha Mungu wengi, ikiwa sio wote, wanaona kwa uwazi mchakato wa kimaadili wa nchi yetu, lakini je, kanisa letu linashikilia mafundisho ya kibiblia au linafuata dunia kwa mabadiliko ya taratibu na kompromisi?

Kinga moja, kanisa la Marekani linaonekana kufanikiwa kifedha. Biashara zetu zinaimarika, pamoja na kiwango chetu cha maisha, ilhali kiroho, Wakristo wengi wanaonekana kupoteza msukumo wa kuwa watiifu kwa Mungu. Je, kanisa litakuwa je katika miaka 40, 50, au 80 ijayo?

Tunapokisoma kitabu cha Matendo, tunaona kitu mara kwa mara. Nguvu za Mungu zinafunuliwa, na nafsi zinaongezwa kwenye ufalme—kila siku.

Kawaida, watu wanapoona jambo wanahitaji, wanalifukuza. Wanapoona kitu ambacho wana uhakika wanapaswa kukipata, wanaweza hata kuwa wakali au wakando wakati wanatafuta njia ya kupata kile kitu.

Yesu anasimulia mifano ya shamba lenye hazina zilizopotea au zilizofichwa—Tena ufalme wa mbinguni ni kama hazina iliyofichwa ndani ya shamba; mtu akipata, anamficha; naye kwa furaha yake aende na auze kila alicho nacho, naye anonunua shamba huo –Mathayo 13:44.

Hapa una mtu ambaye huenda alikuwa ametoroka na maisha yake. Ana mali na afya njema. Anapokwenda nyumbani, anaona kitu ambacho hakijamuona hapo awali, kitu cha thamani kubwa, kitu ambacho lazima awe nacho. Hakuna aliyemlazimisha kuchukua hatua. Pia, hakuchukua siku au wiki kabla hajachukua hatua—alikiuka na kuamua lazima akipate mara moja. Hivyo, aliacha na kuuza kila alicho nacho. (Kuuza ‘nyingi’ hakungevunja shamba. Hapana, lazima auze kila kitu.) Baada ya kununua shamba, sasa anamiliki jambo muhimu zaidi duniani. Atalihifadhi milele, hata pasipo kutoachana nalo, bila kujali gharama. Pia anagundua kuwa hazina hii sio nzuri kwake tu, bali kwa wanadamu wote. Kwa kweli, anafahamu hivi karibuni kwamba kama hatapata hazina hii, akauze kila alicho nacho, na ainunue, atakufa—milele. Watu waliomzunguka huenda wasiemlee—matendo yake, maamuzi yake, vitu anavyofanya—wanaoweza kuchanganyikiwa mwanzoni, kwa nini alifanya alichofanya. Hata hivyo, hawatachanganyikiwa juu ya jambo moja—hazina hii ilikuwa ya thamani ya ulimwengu kwa mtu huyu. Mapenzi yake kwake hayawezi kupingwa.

Mtu huyu sasa anamiliki kitu ndani yake ambacho hutiririsha upendo, furaha, amani, uvumilivu, unyenyekevu, wema, imani, ukomavu wa nafsi, uzembe wa tamaa… –Wagalatia 5:22-23, ambacho ni matunda ya Roho. Anaonekana kuwa na nguvu maalum ndani yake. Anashinda mateso na ugumu kwa urahisi—angalau ndivyo inavyoonekana kwa wale wanaomtazama. Hakushikilia chuki na anawapenda hata maadui wake. Kwa kweli mtu huyu amepata kitu ambacho kilikuwa nadra kuuza kila kitu kuyapata. Halafu, tazama, wengine wanaanza kuuza walicho nacho, ili nao wawe na hazina hii kwao pia.

Kulingana na Biblia, watu wa Mungu wanatarajiwa kuwa nuru ya dunia na chumvi ya nchi. Tujiulize kwa ukakamavu na kwa uaminifu swali hili: “Je, wale waliotuzunguka wanatupata sisi kama nuru na chumvi za kibiblia?!”

Wakati wa kitabu cha Matendo ya Mitume, kulikuwa na mipaka wazi, na kanisa lilikua. Ndiyo, liliadhirika; hata hivyo, bado lilikua, wakati mwingine kila siku.

Ninaposafiri kwenda jamii tofauti, ninaona jambo gumu kuwaelewa. Kuna makundi fulani ya watu yanayoonekana kuonekana tofauti na ulimwengu waliouzunguka, lakini bado, wanaonekana kufanya sawa na Marekani ya kawaida. Maslahi yao ni sawa; matamanio yao ni sawa. Nimekuwa nikijiuliza kwa nini wanaendelea kuonekana tofauti na dunia wakati wanaonekana kuwa na maadili sawa.

Nilikuwa katika duka la kuuza vitu vya chakula wakati mwanamke ambaye sikuwa nimewahi kumwona alinikaribia. Alikuwa mchangamfu sana naye aliniuliza maswali ya nasibu, kisha kabla hajatoka, alisema, “Nawapenda Mennonite; mnavutia sana!” Ilikuwa inavuta moyo—hatukumsababisha uzoefu wa hatia moyoni mwake. Hatujafanya mfano hata kidogo kwake. Badala yake, tulikuwa tukimfurahisha tu.

Haiti, familia yangu ilipokuwa inaingia kanisani au mkutano wa kiroho, wake zingejaribu kuvuta michanganyiko yao ya nguo fupi, wakijaribu kwa kuwa mbio kufunika uchi wao. Mimi hata nimewahi kuona baadhi wakiondoa vito vyao, bila sisi kusema neno! Nuru inafuta giza: inaleta toba. Ndiyo sababu Wakristo walikuwa wakichukiwa na wale waliowazunguka.

Basi kwa nini sisi tumeweza kuwa onyesho la kitamaduni kwa ulimwengu? Nini kimebadilika? Inawezekana tuko tu tukiziagiza desturi za kitamaduni ambazo dunia inazithamini? Je, tunamwacha Mungu nje, huku tukibaki kufanya vitu ambavyo dunia imekuwa ikikubali?

Nikodemos alipokuja kwa Yesu, mara moja alianza kumtukuza Bwana akisema …tunajua kwamba wewe ni mwalimu umetoka kwa Mungu: kwa maana hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya miujiza hii ambayo wewe unafanya, isipokuwa Mungu akiwa pamoja naye –Yohana 3:2.

Hata hivyo, Yesu anaonekana kupuuza maneno haya na anakatia shoka, akisema: …Ndiyo, ndiyo, nawaambia, isipokuwa mtu azaliwa tena, hawezi kuona ufalme wa Mungu –Yohana 3:3. Ni kana kwamba alikuwa anasema, [“Ingawa umejaaliwa kutafuta, unaonekana kuwa na kweli fulani, na wewe ni kiongozi wa Wajuda, lakini jambo la kwanza unalopaswa kujua ni hili: Lazima uzaliwe upya.”] Maneno yenye nguvu. Kisha anaendelea kusema jambo lililo wazi—Kile kilicho zaliwa kwa mwili ni mwili; na kile kilicho zaliwa kwa Roho ni roho –Yohana 3:6.

Leo tunajaribu kujificha nyuma ya mwili wetu (asili yetu isiyogeuzwa). Tuna uhodari wa kulaumiwa kwa mapungufu yetu kwa kusema kwamba tuko katika mwili; wengine hufika mbali kusema sisi sote ni wawaasi na kwa hivyo, hatuwezi kufanya bali kushindwa. Hata hivyo, hapa Yesu anasema kile kilicho mwili ni mwili, na kile kilicho roho ni roho! Ehe, tungeweza kuelewa urahisi katika maneno haya mazito! Mwili ni mwili, sio roho. Na roho ni roho, sio mwili. Tunazaliwa na asili ya Adamu (mwelekeo wa kufanya uovu) tangu tumboni mwa mama yetu. Nabii Yeremia anatueleza kwamba Moyo ni wa udanganyifu kuliko vitu vyote, na kwa madhambi sana; ni nani ayezaye kulitambua? –Yeremia 17:9. Anaendelea kueleza: MIMI BWANA ninatafuta moyo, ninasuluhisha viungo… –Yeremia 17:10.

Tunaweza kujaribu, kama umati, kumfanya asili yetu ya kibinadamu itulizwe kwa tamaa zake na shauku zake zote. Tunaweza kutenda na kujiandaa; tunaweza kumtengeneza mwili kwa njia fulani inayoonekana kwetu kuwa nzuri. Hata hivyo, hakuna tumaini, maana katika mwili hatuwezi kumfurahisha Mungu. Hivyo, kulingana na Yesu lazima tuzaliwe tena. Nikodemos anauliza: …Mtu anawezaje kuzaliwa, akiwa mzee? Aweza kuingia tena katika tumbo la mama yake, na kuzaliwa? –Yohana 3:4.

Yesu kisha anampa hotuba yenye uzito, akisema jinsi lazima kutokea kifo …kama vile Mose alipoinua nyoka jangwani, ndivyo Mwana wa Adamu anapaswa kuinuliwa –Yohana 3:14.

Yesu anaendelea kusema …kila mtu afanyaye uovu anachukia nuru, wala haiji kwa nuru, mambo yake yasiyatafakari –Yohana 3:20. Ikiwa lazima kwanza tukafe, ili tuzaliwe upya, tunakufa vipi? Wale wa Kristo wamekoma mwili pamoja na tamaa na tamaa zake –Wagalatia 5:24. Basi je, mtu anayetafuta kwa dhati anawezaje kibiashara kuwa “alizaliwa tena”?

  • Kwa maana ikiwa usipokuwa ukikiri kwa mdomo wako Bwana Yesu, na ukimwamini moyoni mwako kwamba Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, utahifadhiwa… –Warumi 10:9-10.
  • Kisha Petro akawaambia, Tubadilike, mkabatizwe kila mmoja kwa jina la Yesu Kristo kwa ajili ya masamaha ya dhambi; nami mtapokea zawadi ya Roho Mtakatifu –Matendo 2:38.
  • …neno lililohubiriwa halikuwa na faida kwao, lisikotanganywa na imani kwa wale waliolisikia –Waebrania 4:2.
  • Lakini bila imani haiwezekani kumpendeza yeye… –Waebrania 11:6.
  • Na yeye akaja … akihubiri ubatizo wa toba kwa ajili ya msamaha wa dhambi –Luka 3:3.
  • Mimi ndimi mlango: kwa mimi ikiwa mtu yeyote ingia, atakuwa ameokoka… –Yohana 10:9.
  • …Yeye yeyote atakayenifuata, aanze kujikana, achukue mkazo wake, na anifuate… –Marko 8:34-35.
  • Tazama, nimesimama mlangoni, na kupiga; ikiwa mtu yeyote atasikia sauti yangu, na kufungua mlango, nitaingia kwake, nami nitakula pamoja naye, naye nami nitasubiri naye –Ufunuo 3:20.
  • …Na Yesu akamwambia, Umemwona, naye ndiye anayeongea nawe. Yeye akasema, Bwana, naamini. Naye akamwabudu –Yohana 9:35-38.
  • Kwa maana kwa neema mmeokolewa kwa imani … ni zawadi ya Mungu: sio kwa matendo… –Epesu 2:8-9.

Hapa tunaona kuwa kuna nyanja mbalimbali za kuwa, ya kuwa, na ya kubaki walizaliwa tena. Tuna imani iliyo kamili na isiyotikisika. Tunahitaji kuwa na imani kwa Mungu wa Biblia—Mimi Ni Yeye Mwenyewe, MIMI NIYE. Imani yetu lazima iwe wazi kwa waliotuzunguka—hatuwezi kuifanya ibaki siri. Hatuwezi kuruhusu hofu ya mwanadamu kutuliza imani yetu kwa Mungu. Tunahitaji kuanza kutembea kwa toba. Tunahitaji kutafuta ubatizo kwa ajili ya toba kwa ajili ya msamaha wa dhambi. Tunahitaji kumuona Yesu kama mlango—njia pekee ya kuingia kwa Mungu kupitia ambayo tunapaswa kuingia kisha kutembea kwa haki. Tunahitaji kuona kifo cha Yesu msalabani kama zawadi ya Mungu kwetu kwa wokovu. Na tunapoona Mungu jinsi alivyo na Yesu, Mwana wake, jinsi alivyo, basi tunapaswa kumwabudu. Haya yote (na mengine) ni sehemu ya kuzaliwa tena, au ni matokeo yake, ambayo yanaendelea kuendeleza mchakato wa kubaki walizaliwa tena.

Je, mabadiliko ya kweli bado yanaendelea siku zetu—je, watu wanazaliwa tena jinsi Yesu alivyokuwa akimwelezea Nikodemos? Tunachochea moyo wa sala ya neema-rahisi, tunatazama kwa dharau mwito wa madhabahu bila nguvu, lakini sisi tuna nini kuhusu hitaji letu? Tunahitaji kumkata mwili msalabani. Tunahitaji kuishi si kwa ajili ya nafsi tena. Na tunahitaji kuzaliwa tena kwa roho ya Mungu. Baada ya kutumia muda chini ya miguu ya Yesu, tukijifunza Yeye na Baba Yake na njia zao, tunapaswa kisha kuenda kwa nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu kushiriki na nafsi zilizopotea na zinazokatazwa kile Mungu ametufanyia. Watu wanapoona maisha yetu yaliyobadilika na Mungu, Atavutia nafsi zinazotafuta ndani ya ufalme wa Mwanawe mpendwa.

Kama tumelizaliwa tena kwa kweli, tutakuwa na ushuhuda na shauku ile ile kama mitume. Tutakua katika neema na ufahamu. Tutamruhusu Mungu awe Mungu na Neno Lake liwe Ukweli—hatimaye na kamili! Tutasita kujaribu kuboresha mbuzi miongoni mwa sisi. Badala yake tutashirikisha ujumbe wa Injili nao ili waweze kubadilika—wakajawa kondoo wenye mioyo ya unyoya badala ya mioyo ya jiwe. Nitawapa pia moyo mpya, na roho mpya nitaweka ndani yao; nitaondoa moyo wa jiwe kutoka mwilini mwenu, nami nitawapa moyo wa unyoya. Nitaweka roho yangu ndani yenu, nami nitawafanya mtembee katika sheria zangu, ninyi mtahifadhi hukumu zangu, na kuzifanya –Ezekieli 36:26-27.

Basi kwa nini kuna ukosefu wa waumini waliyezaliwa-again kwetu? Ninaamini dunia hii imetukashifu. Tunatafuta kompromisi popote tu tunapoweza. Hakika, tutavaa tofauti kidogo ikiwa lazima, lakini msituchukue raha zetu zote na furaha. Tunajaza maisha yetu na kila kitu ambacho dunia hii iliyo na magonjwa ya dhambi inatoa—pesa, burudani, anasa, likizo, chakula, na vinywaji, kisha tunapopita shambani lenye hazina iliyofichwa, hata hatuitambui. Iko pale, imekumbukwa tu.

Tunapopiga nyimbo za Sioni na kusali sala za maombi na sifa, Je, Mungu anafanya kazi? Je, kuna furaha ya milele mioyoni mwetu au tunatupwa na mawimbi ya maisha? Je, tuko nje kusaidia vipofu waone au tunajaribu kuficha ukweli kwamba sisi ni Wakristo?!

Tuweze kumaliza maisha haya ya Kikristo yaliyojaribu na kushindwa ambayo hayajui mengi ya ushindi. Tuisha kumaliza kuishi kwa ujinga ambao umekubaliwa na umati unaotuzunguka! Tuweze kumaliza kupenda dunia hii mabaya ya sasa! Tuweze kumaliza ubinafsi na nafsi! Tuweke juu Bwana Yesu Kristo na pamoja tukafungua vita dhidi ya adui wa nafsi zetu. Imani ya kukaa tu nyumbani tukipiga nyimbo imewahi vya kutosha; tuondoke na tupigane kwa kile ambacho wengi kabla yetu waliendelea kupigania. Tunasoma kuhusu hilo katika vitabu vya historia ya kanisa letu. Tunapata faraja na ufahamu kutoka katika Biblia zetu na nakala zetu za Martyrs Mirror. Lakini kizazi kijacho kitaandika nini kuhusu sisi? Kutakuwa na mashahidi wema yoyote yaliyoandikwa kuhusu sisi?

Biblia imejaa ahadi:

  • Muombe, mtapewa; tafuteni, mtapata; piga mlango, utakaguliwa kwenu… –Mathayo 7:7-8.
  • …Mungu … hatakuruhusu kujaribiwa juu ya uwezo wenu; bali pamoja na jaribio Atatengeneza njia ya kukimbia, ili mpate kuhimili -1 Wakorintho 10:13.
  • …Ikiwa mna imani, na hamshutumi … mtamwambia mlima huu, Ohondokeni, mngandamizwa mpaka baharini; litafanyika –Mathayo 21:21.
  • Hili ninalosema basi, Tembei kwa Roho, nao hamtatimiza tamaa ya mwili –Wagalatia 5:16.

Na orodha inaendelea! Je, haya ni sehemu ya maisha yetu? Je, tunaishi kwa ushindi, au tunajificha nyuma ya tamaduni zilizoshindwa bila nguvu?

Mpenzi, Mungu anataka watu wa kumwita wake leo kama alivyo mwanzo. Anatutaka! Ni fikra inayolemea. Mungu anataka kutuinua kwa Roho Wake, anataka kutufumbulia pumzi Yake—Pumzi ya Maisha. Anataka kutubariki kwa baraka za kiroho ambazo hauwezi kuzipima!

Hata hivyo, mtu wa zamani lazima afae—kiwango chake, jina lake, mtazamo wake, umaarufu wake. Mtu wa zamani lazima aweze kuachia nafasi kwa mpya; hawawezi kuishi pamoja ndani ya mwili mmoja. Kulingana na maandiko, ni moja au nyingine. Moja itakufa, na moja itaishi—milele!

Tusiruhusu nyoka (au shetani) kutudanganya tena. Raha za maisha haya ni kwa muda tu. Tunalima kile tunachopanda; hatutaepuka Hukumu. Mungu anataka kutupa Ufalme; anataka kutupa urithi. Anataka kuwa baba kwetu, atuitaje watoto wake wapendwa. Anataka kutembea nasi kupitia njia hii nyembamba. Anataka kututia moyo tunapokuwa chini, na anataka kutupigania tunapokuwa dhaifu. Anataka kutupa utambulisho, sehemu ya familia ya Mungu—watoto Wake. Anataka kutupa nguvu ya kushinda dhambi zote (sio baadhi tu), leo na kesho na kwa maisha yetu yote. Tunaposhindwa, anataka kutupa hamu ya kutubu. Kisha tunapokubali hamu hiyo na kurudi kwake, anataka kutusamehe.

Wakati dunia hii inapokuwa giza zaidi, nuru inapaswa kung’aa kwa urahisi. Je, sisi, kwa kupitia Roho, tunakuwa kile taa ya baharini inasimama imara mbele ya dhoruba? Upepo na mawimbi vinampiga, lakini haiwezi kuhamishwa. Nuru yake inang’aza hata nyakati za giza kabisa, ikitoa tumaini kwa nafsi zilizo na uchovu zilizokosa mwelekeo maishani. Msingi wake hauzunguka; kusudi lake hakubadiliki.

Tunaweza kujaza vichwa vyetu kwa maarifa na kujua vitu vyote sahihi vya kusema na kufanya. Hata hivyo, ikiwa hatutorodheshwa na Roho wa Mungu, sisi ni tamaduni tu zitakazobadilika kila kizazi. Mabadiliko haya yataendelea hadi kizazi cha mwisho kimezama kabisa katika bahari za dunia hii. Wakati huo huo, mwizi wa nafsi zetu anapata zaidi kwa yeye mwenyewe.

Huu ni uwanja wa vita halisi—wengine watafaulu, wengi watapoteza. Hasara ni kubwa, kubwa kuliko niwezavyo kuelezea; na ushindi pia ni mkubwa.

Kristiani wa karne ya ishirini na moja, utafanya nini?
